core_meaning.primary_meaning: Syahmi corresponds to the Arabic form شَهْمِي and is glossed in this record as “Of noble character (Malay form).” The record associates the form with root ش ه م (sh-h-m). The lexical gloss describes the word-form; Qur’anic occurrence, religious recommendation, popularity, and a name-bearer’s character are separate claims and are not established by this gloss alone.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Syahmi corresponds to the Arabic form شَهْمِي (Arabic root ش ه م (sh-h-m); شَهْمِيّ (Shahmī)). Its core sense is syahmi; of noble character (malay form). Syahmi is the Malay form of Arabic شَهْمِيّ (Shahmī), the relative form of شَهَامَة (nobility), used as a male given name.

faq.a: Documented usage records Syahmi as a boy's name; actual use can vary by community.
